Understand the process of Application Submission (Application is common for all schemes)
1
Enter Class 10 (SSLC / CBSE / ICSE / KOS) Registration Number of the student
2
Enter the RD number of Caste, Income, EWS certificate issued by Revenue Department (whichever is applicable)
3
Enter the Unique Disability ID (UDID) of the student issued by Govt of India (If the student is a person with Disabilities)
4
Enter University/ Educational Board Registration number of the student for the current course
5
Enter the Counselling number, year and course details (if the student is admitted to any professional course through counselling)
6
Enter Class 12 (SSLC / CBSE / ICSE) Registration Number of the student (only for 1st year students studying Undergraduate courses)
7
Enter previous academic year University / Board Registration Number and other details to fetch result details (For students other than SC and ST category)
8
Student must upload documents for e-attestation from concerned department officer (if applicable)
(Check out the list for applicability to upload documents and concerned approving authority)
9
Select whether the student is a Dayscholar or a Hosteller
10
Enter One Time Registration (OTR) number issued by National Scholarship Portal (only for SC, ST and OBC students)

About Us
The State Scholarship Portal (SSP) – a unified platform developed by Center for e-Governance, DPAR (e-Governance), Government of Karnataka ensures disbursement of Prematric & Postmatric Scholarship under various schemes of Govt of Karnataka. SSP provides a platform for receipt of online applications and disbursal of scholarship by sponsoring departments through DBT to the Aadhar seeded bank account of the beneficiary.

Understand the process of Application Submission (Application is common for all schemes)
1
Enter Class 10 (SSLC / CBSE / ICSE / KOS) Registration Number of the student
2
Enter the RD number of Caste, Income, EWS certificate issued by Revenue Department (whichever is applicable)
3
Enter the Unique Disability ID (UDID) of the student issued by Govt of India (If the student is a person with Disabilities)
4
Enter University/ Educational Board Registration number of the student for the current course
5
Enter the Counselling number, year and course details (if the student is admitted to any professional course through counselling)
6
Enter Class 12 (SSLC / CBSE / ICSE) Registration Number of the student (only for 1st year students studying Undergraduate courses)
7
Enter previous academic year University / Board Registration Number and other details to fetch result details (For students other than SC and ST category)
8
Student must upload documents for e-attestation from concerned department officer (if applicable) (Check out the list for applicability to upload documents and concerned approving authority)
9
Select whether the student is a Dayscholar or a Hosteller
10
Enter One Time Registration (OTR) number issued by National Scholarship Portal (only for SC, ST and OBC students)

About Us

The State Scholarship Portal (SSP) – a unified platform developed by Center for e-Governance, DPAR (e-Governance), Government of Karnataka ensures disbursement of Prematric & Postmatric Scholarship under various schemes of Govt of Karnataka. SSP provides a platform for receipt of online applications and disbursal of scholarship by sponsoring departments through DBT to the Aadhar seeded bank account of the beneficiary.

department: Department of Women and Child Development
description: Financial security scheme offering monthly financial support of ₹2,000 to the woman head of eligible families in Karnataka.
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of ₹2,000 per month into bank account
Financial independence and empowerment of female heads of households
eligibility: Woman head of the family named in BPL or APL ration cards
Age of applicant must be minimum 18 years and below 60 years
Neither applicant nor spouse should be an income tax payer
Annual family income should not exceed ₹2 lakh
documents_required: Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar
application_process: Apply online at Seva Sindhu Portal (https://sevasindhugs1.karnataka.gov.in/gl-sp/) or visit nearest Grama One/Karnataka One centers.

description: Free electricity scheme providing up to 200 units of free power per month to all residential households in Karnataka.
benefits: Zero electricity bill for monthly usage up to 200 units
Coverage for all domestic electricity consumers and tenants
eligibility: All domestic residential electricity connections in Karnataka
Monthly average electricity consumption should be within 200 units
One connection per household/Aadhaar number
documents_required: Electricity Account ID (Account ID on Bill)
Rental Agreement or Voter ID (for tenants)
application_process: Apply online via Seva Sindhu Portal under Gruha Jyoti tab.

department: Department of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Unemployment allowance and skill development training scheme for degree and diploma graduates in Karnataka.
benefits: ₹3,000 monthly allowance for unemployed graduates
₹1,500 monthly allowance for unemployed diploma holders
Free skill training and job placement assistance
eligibility: Applicants must be between 18 and 30 years of age
Must have passed Degree/Diploma in academic year 2023-24 onwards
Must be unemployed for at least 180 days after graduation
application_process: Register online on Seva Sindhu Portal with Aadhaar authentication.

department: Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs
description: Food security scheme providing 10 kg of free rice per person per month to BPL and Antyodaya cardholders.
benefits: 10 kg free foodgrains or cash equivalent (DBT) per person per month
Eradication of hunger and malnutrition in poor households
eligibility: Families holding BPL (Below Poverty Line) or AAY (Antyodaya Anna Yojana) ration cards in Karnataka
Family annual income below ₹1.2 lakh
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Active Bank Account linked with Aadhaar
application_process: Automatic entitlement for valid BPL ration card holders at fair price shops.

description: Free bus travel scheme for women residents of Karnataka across state-run KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, and KKRTC non-AC buses.
benefits: 100% free bus travel within Karnataka state borders
Applicable on ordinary and express bus services
eligibility: All women, girls, and transgender persons residing in Karnataka
No age or income limit
documents_required: Shakti Smart Card or Govt Photo ID Card (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving License) proving Karnataka address
application_process: Apply for Shakti Smart Card on Seva Sindhu portal or present govt photo ID during bus travel.

description: Post-Matric scholarship scheme providing tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance to SC/ST/OBC/Minority students.
benefits: Full tuition fee reimbursement and exam fee waiver
Monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month
Hostel fee assistance
eligibility: Students pursuing Class 11, Class 12, ITI, Diploma, Graduation, Post-Graduation, or Ph.D.
Applicants must be between 16 and 35 years of age
Family annual income should not exceed ₹2.5 lakh for SC/ST and ₹1 lakh for OBC
application_process: Apply online at State Scholarship Portal (SSP) at https://ssp.karnataka.gov.in/

department: Karnataka Minorities / Backward Classes Development Corporation
description: Irrigation scheme providing free borewell drilling and pump set installation for small and marginal farmers.
benefits: 100% subsidy for borewell drilling and pump installation
Electrification of borewells up to ₹3.5 lakh value
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers belonging to SC, ST, OBC, or Minority communities
Must own between 2 to 5 acres of agricultural land
Annual family income should not exceed ₹1.5 lakh
application_process: Apply online via Seva Sindhu or KMDC portal (https://kmdc.karnataka.gov.in/)

department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
description: Educational scholarship scheme for children of farmers in Karnataka to pursue higher education.
benefits: Annual scholarship ranging from ₹2,500 to ₹11,000 depending on course level
Direct Benefit Transfer to student's bank account
eligibility: Children of registered farmers owning agricultural land in Karnataka
Enrolled in Class 11, 12, ITI, BA, BSc, BCom, MBBS, BE, or Post-Graduation
Age of student between 16 and 25 years
application_process: Automatic scholarship disbursement via SSP portal using FRUITS ID integration.

description: Self-employment credit-linked subsidy scheme for setting up micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors.
benefits: Capital subsidy up to 35% for SC/ST/Women/Minority entrepreneurs (max ₹10 lakh subsidy)
Bank loan assistance up to ₹25 lakh project cost
eligibility: Applicants must be between 18 and 45 years of age (50 years for SC/ST/Women/Ex-servicemen)
Minimum 8th standard pass for project cost above ₹10 lakh
One person per family eligible

description: Subsidized education loan scheme for minority community students pursuing professional courses.
benefits: Education loan up to ₹3,000,000 at low interest rate of 2% per annum
Covers Engineering, MBBS, BDS, MBA, MCA, and AYUSH courses
eligibility: Students belonging to Muslim, Christian, Jain, Buddhist, Sikh, or Parsi communities
Must be resident of Karnataka
Annual family income should not exceed ₹8.0 lakh
Age of student between 17 and 30 years
